literal_meaning: বহু কণ্ঠের সম্মিলিত তান বা গুঞ্জন
figurative_meaning_en: the combined murmur of many voices
example_sentences_in_english: The meeting room filled with a kolotan of voices.
The market was alive with the kolotan of shoppers.
note: An onomatopoeic expression capturing the auditory essence of crowded Bengali social settings.
